entities.name: Squelch
entities.description: Inventive Izzet goblin wizard on Ravnica who teamed up with Ruric Thar in the Implicit Maze.

entities.name: Ruric Thar
entities.description: Ogre in the Implicit Maze who agreed to pay Squelch in chickens.

entities.name: Implicit Maze
entities.description: Contest in which Squelch and Ruric Thar teamed up.

entities.name: Boros
entities.description: Soldiers who faced Squelch and Ruric Thar.

events.summary: A disheveled goblin, Squelch, approached Ruric Thar to team up, in exchange for chickens.
events.quote: The deal was, the goblin would help the ogre out, and the ogre would pay him in chickens.

events.summary: Squelch jammed a metal spike into a war beast's head, causing the Boros war engine to explode.
events.quote: pulled a metal spike from an unseen pocket and jammed it into the top of the creature's head

events.summary: The path clear, Ruric Thar advanced with Squelch riding in a basket on their back.
events.quote: Now clear to proceed, Ruric Thar lumbered forward, and Squelch climbed onto their back.

relations.quote: he teamed up with Ruric Thar during the running of the Implicit Maze
Squelch is an Izzet goblin wizard on the plane of Ravnica
